verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs say it provides an OpenAPI Specification v3 file, the same one it uses to generate its own server-side libraries, and they point developers to it for generating client libraries in Java, Python, Node.js and other languages. A probe found nothing at the conventional paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known). That only means the file isn't at those guessed locations, so it doesn't contradict the claim. Missing for 10: a documented direct download URL for the spec, and hands-on confirmation that the file can actually be fetched.
